commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+4' The free kick from long range, taken by Lorient, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
90+1' 1 - 1 Bamba Dieng (Lorient) breaks through before collecting a brilliant pass and producing a precise strike to beat the goalkeeper. The ball went into the bottom right corner.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
88' Frank Magri races towards the box before laying off to Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse), who picks it up but drags a shot well wide of the left post from the edge of the box.
87' Benjamin Mendy (Lorient) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
83' Thomas Leonard shows a yellow card to Benjamin Mendy (Lorient) for a tough tackle.
83' The foul by Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Thomas Leonard.

83' A neat pass is well received by Yanis Begraoui (Toulouse), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the middle of the target. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
80' Regis Le Bris has decided to substitute Darlin Yongwa and he is replaced by Vincent Le Goff (Lorient).
80' Substitution. Theo Le Bris (Lorient) replaces Eli Junior Kroupi.
80' Gabriel Suazo comes off the pitch to be replaced by Moussa Diarra (Toulouse).
79' Here is a change. Aron Donnum is going off and Carles Martinez gives the last tactical orders to Yanis Begraoui (Toulouse).
79' Here comes a substitution. Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) is brought on as a substitute for Niklas Schmidt.
78' Benjamin Mendy (Lorient) hammered the ball from a long-range free kick only into the defensive wall.
76' Toulouse enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
74' A player from Toulouse pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle.
72' 1 - 0 Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) rises above the defence to meet a delightful cross and plants a powerful header into the roof of the net. The ball was slightly deflected in off the crossbar.
71' Julien Ponceau (Lorient) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Thomas Leonard didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
70' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Benjamin Mendy (Lorient). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
69' Toulouse take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
68' The Toulouse players are exchanging some short passes.
66' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Bamba Dieng (Lorient) comes onto the pitch so that Sirine Doucoure can be given a rest.
66' Substitution. Jean-Victor Makengo leaves the pitch and is replaced by Benjamin Mendy (Lorient).
64' The Toulouse players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
62' Carles Martinez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) replacing Ibrahim Cissoko.
60' The Toulouse players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
57' Toulouse are enjoying a spell of pressure at the moment, but one of the defenders gets it clear.
55' Tiemoue Bakayoko is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Julien Ponceau (Lorient).
55' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range low towards the middle of the goal, but Yvon Mvogo is equal to it and makes an easy save.
53' Thomas Leonard blows his whistle as Gedeon Kalulu (Lorient) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
51' Neat passing move from Toulouse in order to create new attacking opportunities.
49' One of the Toulouse players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul.

47' Ibrahim Cissoko (Toulouse) controls a neat pass and has options, but decides to shoot from distance. The ball flies towards the middle of the goal, but Yvon Mvogo is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45+4' A player from Toulouse commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
45+3' Frank Magri (Toulouse) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the middle of the goal, but Yvon Mvogo is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
45+1' A player from Lorient takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
45+1' Lorient keep the ball well and push forward with purpose, but here comes an interception from the opposition.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.

43' Romain Faivre (Lorient) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the middle of the goal, but Guillaume Restes has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
41' A player from Lorient commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
40' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
39' A pass from Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) is intercepted by Yvon Mvogo and the move breaks down.
35' Sirine Doucoure (Lorient) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
33' Thomas Leonard shows a yellow card to Montassar Talbi (Lorient), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
31' It's time for a substitution. Warren Kamanzi (Toulouse) comes on in place of Mikkel Desler.
31' Darlin Yongwa (Lorient) takes a short pass in his stride and attempts to beat the keeper from mid-range, but the shot screeches just wide of the right post.
30' The corner is swung in but Toulouse can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
29' Lorient control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
24' A player from Lorient brings down an opponent and commits a foul.
22' One of the Toulouse players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul.
19' Great teamplay by Lorient as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
17' Romain Faivre (Lorient) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.
15' Niklas Schmidt (Toulouse) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the middle of the goal, but Yvon Mvogo is equal to it and makes an easy save.
15' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) latches on to an accurate pass into the box and immediately unleashes a low shot goalwards. His effort is well saved by the keeper.
12' Toulouse are playing excellent possession football at the moment by exchanging some long passes.

10' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Yvon Mvogo pulls off an easy save.
9' Tiemoue Bakayoko (Lorient) sees a yellow card from Thomas Leonard after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
6' None of the Toulouse players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
4' Toulouse are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
2' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Lorient.
2' Romain Faivre (Lorient) crosses the ball from the free kick, but it goes out of play.
1' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Thomas Leonard ignores the protests.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Lorient will have the kick-off.
Thomas Leonard will officiate today.
